name: install_plugin
description: Get the install link for a plugin the customer already has a purchased license for (see list_purchased_plugins). Only call this after the customer has explicitly agreed to install it -- never speculatively. For security reasons, installation must be completed on the web, not through this assistant -- this tool does not install the plugin; it returns an `install_url` for the customer to finish installing it themselves.

name.description: The plugin's exact display `name`, from list_purchased_plugins -- used to build the customer-facing link text without a separate lookup.
